met_analysis:
The Monsoon trough at mean sea level continues to pass through Sri Ganganagar, Hissar, Meerut, Shahjahanpur, Gorakhpur, Muzaffarpur and thence east-southeastwards to south Assam.
The Western Disturbance as a trough in middle tropospheric westerlies with its axis at 5.8 km above mean sea level roughly along Long. 72°E to the north of Lat. 30°N persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulationover Northeast Bihar & neighbourhood at 3.1 km above mean sea level persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over South Bangladesh & neighbourhood at 5.8 km above mean sea level persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over Northeast Assam & neighbourhood between 1.5 & 3.1 km above mean sea level persists.
The trough in westerlies roughly along Long. 89°E to the north of Lat. 21°N upto 1.5 km above mean sea level persists.
